x-m-h2-01.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
x-m-h2-01.goal: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.
x-m-h2-01.material: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
x-m-h2-01.thinking.2: Gadzirisa mhinduro uye utsanangure kuti nei
x-m-h2-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva nemaitiro ekutanga e ma logarithm
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumhinduro yaMinho une dambudziko. (Kana mitsara yakawanda inotevedzana ine dambudziko, unogona kusarudza mumwe wavo chete.)
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa makosha ari pakupera kwemhinduro zvakananga mu equation iri mumutsara wekutanga. Chii chinoitika kukukosha kwakaiswa mukati me logarithm?
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.line.5: Saka ma solution ndi x = 5 ne x = −1, maviri.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.prompt: Udza Minho mhinduro yakarurama nechikonzero. Sanganisira dambudziko rinoitika kana ukaisa x=−1 mu equation yekutanga.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga uchitarisa chikonzero chekuchinjwa kwe expression mumutsara mumwe nemumwe.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa x=−1 ne x=5 imwe neimwe mu argument dze logarithm mu equation yekutanga uye utarise kuti makosha anova chii.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei x=−1 isingagoni kuva solution uchishandisa kukosha kwe argument?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti mamiriro api aidiwa expression isati yachinjwa?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaisa here x=5 mu equation yekutanga kutarisa kuti inogutsa?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.0: Solution yega ndi x=5. Kana ndikaisa x=−1, argument ndeye negative senge log₂(−2), saka haina kutsanangurwa. Saka 5 chete, inogutsa mamiriro e argument x>3, ndiyo solution.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.1: Kana uchigadzirisa equation, ma argument anofanira kugara ari positive. x−1>0 ne x−3>0, saka x>3 inodiwa, uye x=−1 haisi mu renji iyi, saka inofanira kurashwa. Saka mhinduro ndi x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.2: Kubva pamamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0, x>3. x=−1 iri kunze kwe renji, saka isa kuruboshwe, uye mhinduro ndi5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.3: Mhinduro ndi5. Kuisa x=−1 kunopa log₂(−2), iyo isina kutsanangurwa, saka haisi solution.

x-m-h2-04.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
x-m-h2-04.goal: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.
x-m-h2-04.material: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
x-m-h2-04.thinking.0: Gadzira iwe pachako mamiriro anogutsa mamiriro
x-m-h2-04.prereq.0: Trigonometric ratios nehukama pakati pemativi nema angles mu triangle
x-m-h2-04.prereq.1: Huwandu hwema roots e quadratic equation
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira ma triangles anogutsa mamiriro kana b=8. Wana kureba kuviri kwakasiyana kunogoneka c kwedivi AB.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza mhinduro dzose dze equation iyoyo dzinogona kushandiswa sekureba kwedivi.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Kureba kwedivi kunofanira kuva kukuru kupfuura 0.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Equation yaunowana nekuisa a=7, b=8 mu law of cosines a²=b²+c²−2bc·cos60° haishandi.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.explain: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mitengo yose ye b inogona kushandiswa kuramba chirevo chaGaeun (kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, kunogara kuri ma triangles maviri). Kune b imwe neimwe, seta equation ye c nenzira imwechete.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kune b imwe neimwe, ronga zvakare 49=b²+c²−bc se quadratic mu c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa ne discriminant kana equation yakarongwa zvakare ine real roots, uye utarisewo kana mutengo uri mukati memamiriro b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.a: Inova c²−10c+51=0, isina real roots. Iyi i mamiriro apo hapana triangle inogona kugadzirwa zvachose.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.b: b=5 i kunze kwemamiriro 'b i yakakura kupfuura 7', saka hairamba chirevo chaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.c: b=8 i mamiriro apo ma triangles maviri anogadzirwa, saka inotsigira chirevo chaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.d: Inova c²−12c+95=0, isina real roots. Hapana triangle inogona kugadzirwa zvachose.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.e: b=7 haina kusanganisirwa mumamiriro 'yakakura kupfuura 7.' I mamiriro asina hukama nechirevo chaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.f: Inova c²−9c+32=0, isina real roots. Hapana triangle inogona kugadzirwa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.explain: Nelaw of cosines, 49=b²+c²−bc, ndiko kuti, c²−bc+(b²−49)=0. Kuti mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana dzepositive dzibude, discriminant 196−3b² inofanira kuva positive uye b>7, saka b inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura anenge 8.08. Kune b=9, 10, 12 hapana real roots, saka hapana triangle inogona kugadzirwa zvachose. b=5 ne 7 i kunze kwemamiriro b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Gaeun mumutsara mumwe kana miviri. Tsanangura nemienzaniso kuti ma triangles mangani anogadzirwa zvichienderana nemutengo we b.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa mhedzisiro ye b=8 yawakawana pamusoro nemhedzisiro dzemimwe mitengo ye b (semuenzaniso 9, 10).
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Seta equation ye c nenzira imwechete uye uverenge kuti kune mitengo yepositive ye c inokodzera ingani.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa, nequation ye c, kuti kune ma triangles mangani kune mutengo we b wawakapa here?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura zvose mamiriro ane ma triangles maviri nemamiriro asina chero here?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura, kunyange zvisina kujeka, nei ma triangles achirega kugadzirwa kana b ichikura here?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.0: Kwete nguva dzose. Kana b=8, c=3 ne 5, saka kune maviri, asi kana b=10, equation ye c haina mhinduro, saka hapana triangle inogadzirwa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.1: Kwete. Kana b ikakura zvakanyanya, hapana triangle inogadzirwa. Kana b i 9 kana 10, quadratic equation ye c haina real roots, saka haishande. Kune maviri chete kana b i yakakura zvishoma kupfuura 7, sa b=8.

x-m-h2-05.title: 1, 2, 4, 8, … Nhamba inotevera i ipi?
x-m-h2-05.goal: Ona mutemo wakafungidzirwa kubva pama terms ekutanga mashoma uchiputsika ne data itsva, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako.
x-m-h2-05.material: Kana ukaisa mapoinzi n pa circle uye ukabatanidza mapoinzi maviri ega ega nesegment, circle inogovaniswa kuita zvikamu zvakati wandei. Isa mapoinzi kuti hapana segments tatu dzinosangana papoinzi imwe. Daidza huwandu hwezvikamu aₙ. (Pasina mufananidzo: ne poinzi 1 hapana segments, saka kune chikamu 1, uye ne mapoinzi 2 segment imwe inogovanisa circle kuita zvikamu zviviri.)
x-m-h2-05.thinking.0: Fungidzira mutemo kubva pama terms mashoma
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe. Padanho rega rega, sarudza fungidziro kana kutonga.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rega rega, siyanisa zvaunogona kutaura kubva pa data kusvika zvino nezvausati waziva.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kana data itsva yabuda, ipise padivi pefungidziro yako yekutanga uye uenzanise kana yaiva yakarurama.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Ndakaverenga zvakananga ne mapoinzi 1, 2, 3, ne 4, huwandu hwezvikamu hwaiva 1, 2, 4, 8.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofungidzira chii nezve huwandu hwezvikamu kana pane mapoinzi 5?
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kutarisa ma terms mana ekutanga chete, mutemo wekuwanza ka2 i fungidziro nyore zvikuru. Asi haugone kuva nechokwadi chemutemo kubva pama terms mashoma.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kutarisa ma terms mana ekutanga chete, mutemo wekuwanza ka2 i fungidziro nyore zvikuru.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ichava 12. Inokwira ne 4 nguva imwe neimwe
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mu 1, 2, 4, 8, misiyano i 1, 2, 4, inoramba ichikura. Mutemo we 4 nguva imwe neimwe haungaenderani ne data.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvinoratidzika kuti ichava 16, asi zvakaoma kuva nechokwadi tisati taverenga zvakananga
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uri kufunga nezvekufungidzira nekutarisa sezvinhu zvakaparadzana.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndakaisa mapoinzi 5 uye ndakaverenga zvakananga, uye yaiva 16.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Yakaenderana kusvika pa term yechishanu, saka kuvimba kwako kwakakura, asi ichiri humbowo chete.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: I 32. Yakaenderana kusvika ku 5, saka mutemo wekuwanza ka2 wakasimbiswa
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kuenderana kusvika ku 5 kunoita kuti uvimbe zvakawanda, asi haugone kuva nechokwadi kubva pa izvozvo oga.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvichida i 32, asi handizvi kuva nechokwadi kusvika ndaverenga mamiriro e mapoinzi 6 zvakananga
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakasiyanisa kuti fungidziro yakasimba zvakadini nekuva nechokwadi.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inogona kuva shoma kupfuura 32, saka ndichaverenga mamiriro e mapoinzi 6 zvakananga
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uri kusiya mukana wekuti mutemo unogona kuputsika uye uri kuedza kuuyedza.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Pandakaverenga mamiriro e mapoinzi 6 zvakananga, yaiva 31. (Cherechedza: ne mapoinzi 7 i 57.)
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Unofunga chii nezve mutemo ‘aₙ=2ⁿ⁻¹ (2 kune power n−1)’?
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Sequence inoenda 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 31, 57, saka mutemo wekuwanza ka2 haisi mutemo we sequence iyi.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Pa term yechi 6 yaiva 31, saka mutemo uyu haienderane ne sequence iyi. Kunyange ma terms ekutanga akati wandei akafanana, haisi sequence imwechete
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakagamuchira kuti counterexample imwe chete inoputsa mutemo.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: n=6 chete ndiyo isiri yakajairika, uye mamwe ose i 2ⁿ⁻¹
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pa n=7 i 57, iyo yakasiyana ne 2⁶=64, saka pane zvisiri zvakajairika zvakawanda.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yakaenderana kusvika ku 5, saka yechi 6 inofanira kunge yakaverengwa zvisina kururama
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hauvimbi nemhedzisiro uye uri kuedza kuchengeta mutemo. Unogona kutarisa kuverenga zvakare, asi 57 haienderanewo nemutemo.
x-m-h2-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga mutemo wekuwanza ka2 wairatidzika wakakodzera, asi waputsika ne data itsva (n=6). Fungidziro yakaitwa kubva pama terms mashoma i humbowo chete kusvika yasimbiswa, uye kuvimba nemutemo unoda tsananguro yekuti nei unoshanda kune n yose.
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora nei usingagone kugadzirisa mutemo nekuti ma terms ekutanga mashoma akafanana, uye chii chimwe chaunoda kuvimba kuti mutemo wakarurama.
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa huwandu hwezvikamu 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 31 padivi pefungidziro yako yekutanga.
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti 'kutarisa' mutemo kunosiyana sei ne 'kutsanangura chikonzero.'
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura mutengo chaiwo apo mutemo waputsika (n=6, 31) here?
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa 'kutarisa ma terms akawanda' ne 'kutsanangura chikonzero' here?
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti wakagadzirisa sei fungidziro yako yekutanga here?
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.model.0: Kunyange ma terms mashanu ekutanga 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 akafanana nemutemo wekuwanza ka2, term yechitanhatu i 31, saka mutemo waputsika. Haufaniri kugadzirisa mutemo nekutarisa ma terms mashoma chete; unoda chikonzero (humbowo) chekuti nei unoshanda kune n yose.
x-m-h2-05.s.s2.model.1: Kutarisa ma terms mamwe i humbowo, kwete chokwadi. Sequence iyi i 31 pa n=6, saka mutemo wema powers e 2 wakanga wakanganisa. Kuvimba nemutemo, unofanira kugona kutsanangura nei unoshanda kuma terms ose.

x-m-h2-06.title: Tarisa gadziriso yakawana general term kubva pahuwandu hwe sequence
x-m-h2-06.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise dambudziko mugadziriso inowana general term kubva pahuwandu Sₙ we sequence, uye utsvage iwe pachako mamiriro apo inogona kunyorwa sefomula imwechete.
x-m-h2-06.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaSeoa yekuwana general term kana huwandu Sₙ hwema terms n ekutanga e sequence {aₙ} i Sₙ = n² + 2n + 1. (Verenga Sₙ se ‘S sub n’, aₙ se ‘a sub n’, uye Sₙ₋₁ se ‘S sub n minus 1’.)
x-m-h2-06.prereq.0: Zvinoreva huwandu Sₙ ne general term aₙ ye sequence
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mugadziriso yaSeoa une dambudziko. (Kana mitsetse yakati wandei yakatevedzana i dambudziko, unogona kusarudza imwe chete pazvo.)
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kana mamiriro (renji ye n) pakutanga kwemutsetse mumwe nemumwe akafanana nerenji iri mumhedziso yekupedzisira.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Wana term yekutanga a₁ zvakananga kubva pa tsanangudziko ye Sₙ, uye uienzanise nemutengo uri mumutsetse 5.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.line.3: Saka kune natural numbers n dzose, aₙ = 2n + 1
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo dambudziko. Mutsetse 1 wakati n≥2, saka aₙ=2n+1 i fomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 chete. Term yekutanga inofanira kuwanikwa zvakaparadzana: a₁=S₁=1+2+1=4, iyo yakasiyana ne 2·1+1=3. Saka a₁=3 mumutsetse 5 haina kururamawo.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora general term yakarurama uye utsanangure chii chakasiiwa naSeoa.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Fomula yekuwana a₁ yakatsanangurwa zvakasiyana ne aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. Rangarira zvinoreva term yekutanga.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mutengo we 2n+1 pa n=1 nemutengo we S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakawana a₁ kubva ku S₁ panzvimbo ye aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁ here?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti unofanira kutarisa kana fomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 inoshandawo kune n=1 here?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora general term munzira mbiri panzvimbo yefomula imwechete here?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.0: a₁=S₁=4, uye kune n≥2, aₙ=2n+1. Seoa haana kutarisa kana fomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 inoshandawo kune n=1. Kuisa n=1 kunopa 3, iyo yakasiyana ne a₁=4.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.1: General term inofanira kunyorwa muzvikamu zviviri: a₁=4, uye aₙ=2n+1 (n≥2). S₁=4, asi kuisa n=1 mu 2n+1 kunopa 3, saka hazvienzani. Term yekutanga inofanira kuwanikwa zvakaparadzana.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.prompt: Kune Sₙ = p·n² + q·n + r (p, q, r i integers, p≠0), wana (p, q, r) dzakasiyana nhatu dzinoita kuti mutengo waunowana nekuisa n=1 mufomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 uenzane ne a₁, kuti general term inyorwe sefomula imwechete.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kune Sₙ=pn²+qn+r, nyora Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁ kune n≥2 maererano ne p ne q.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa mutengo waunowana nekuisa n=1 mufomula iyoyo ne S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c1: p, q, r i integers uye p haifaniri kuva 0.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Mutengo wefomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 pa n=1 wakaenzana ne a₁=S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Mutengo p+q wefomula p(2n−1)+q yakawanikwa kune n≥2 pa n=1 haienzani ne S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.explain: Kune n≥2, aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁=p(2n−1)+q, saka kuisa n=1 kunopa p+q. a₁=S₁=p+q+r, saka zvinoenzana chete kana r=0. Sₙ=n²+2n+1 ine r=1, saka term yekutanga yaifanira kubatwa zvakaparadzana.

x-m-h2-07.title: ∞−∞ yakaenzana ne 0 here? Kutarisa zvirevo zveshamwari mbiri
x-m-h2-07.goal: Edza zvirevo zviviri nekuverenga nenhamba, tsanangura kwakanganisa kufunga kwepfungwa, uye wobva wawana limit uchishandisa algebra.
x-m-h2-07.material: Minsu akati, ‘Kana x ichikura isingaperi, √(x²+x) inoswedera padyo ne x, saka √(x²+x) − x inoswedera padyo ne 0.’ Seoa akati, ‘Haiswederi padyo ne 0, inoswedera padyo nenhamba yepositive.’ Maitiro ekuverenga: √(x²+x) i root ye x square pamwe ne x, uye ‘x inokura isingaperi’ i x→∞.
x-m-h2-07.prereq.0: Zvinoreva limit kana x ichikura isingaperi
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.prompt: Unogona kushandisa calculator. Sarudza integers dzatatu x dzine 100 kana kupfuura, verenga mutengo we √(x²+x) − x, uuite round kusvika pa decimal places matatu, uye uuise se (x, mutengo). Kuisa x dzakasiyana nhatu kunopedza. (Kana chirevo chaMinsu chakarurama, mutengo uyu unofanira kusvika padyo ne 0 kana x yakakura.)
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x=100 ne x=1000 mu √(x²+x)−x uye uverenge.

x-m-h2-09.title: Poinzi apo derivative iri 0 inogara iri extremum here?
x-m-h2-09.goal: Gadzira counterexample iwe pachako kuchirevo che 'kana derivative i0, pane extremum', uye urongedze mamiriro anodiwa kuextremum.
x-m-h2-09.material: Mudzidzi akati, 'Kune cubic function f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, kana pane c ine f'(c)=0, saka inogara iine extremum (local maximum kana local minimum) pa x=c.' (f' iderivative ye f, uye f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b. Extremum ndiko kukosha kwefunction papoinzi apo inochinja kubva pakukwira kuenda pakudzika, kana kubva pakudzika kuenda pakukwira.)
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.prompt: Tsvaga mapairi matatu akasiyana eintegers a, b apo f ine c ine f'(c)=0 asi isina extremum (haidzikiri pa interval ipi zvayo), kugadzira counterexamples.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira girafu ye f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b (parabola inovhurika kumusoro). Kuti f ive neextremum, chiratidzo che f' chinofanira kuchinja.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti parabola iyi inofanira kusangana sei ne x-axis kuti f'(c)=0 asi chiratidzo che f' chisingachinji.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.ok.c2: f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b inobata x-axis. Pane c ine f'(c)=0, asi chiratidzo che f' hachichinji.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Discriminant 4a²−12b ye f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b haisi 0. Kana iri huru kupfuura 0, chiratidzo che f' chinochinja uye extremum inoonekwa, uye kana iri diki kupfuura 0, hapana c ine f'(c)=0.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Kana f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ichibata x-axis (discriminant 4a²−12b=0, ndiko kuti, a²=3b), saka f'(x)=3(x+a/3)²≥0, saka kunyange pane poinzi apo f'=0, f inoramba ichikwira. Semuenzaniso, kana a=0, b=0, saka f(x)=x³ uye f'(0)=0 asi hapana extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Mumafunction awakagadzira pamusoro, f'(c)=0 asi hapana extremum. Ndeapi mamiriro akakodzera zvikuru ekuva neextremum?
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa chiratidzo che f'(x) kune function yawakagadzira munhanho yapfuura, kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe c.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza zvinoreva extremum (inochinja kubva pakukwira kuenda pakudzika, nezvimwe) nesarudzo imwe neimwe.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.a: f'(c)=0 uye chiratidzo che f' chinochinja kumativi ose maviri e c
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.a: Wakaratidza kuti pamusoro pe f'(c)=0, mamiriro ekuti kukwira nekudzika zvichinjane anodiwa.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.b: Kana f'(c)=0, inogara iri extremum chero chiratidzo chiri chipi
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.b: Mumuenzaniso waakagadzira kare (f(x)=x³ nezvimwe), f'(0)=0 asi hapana extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.c: f'(c)=0 uye kukosha kwefunction f(c) kunofanirawo kuva 0
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.c: Kukosha kwe f(c) hakuna chekuita nekuti pane extremum here. Kune f(x)=x³+1, f'(0)=0 ne f(0)=1, asi hapana extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.d: Kana f'(c)>0, slope yetangent line papoinzi iyoyo ipositive, saka function inokwira. Haisi muna vanosarudzwa vekuva neextremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.explain: Kuti c ive extremum, f'(c)=0 uye chiratidzo che f' chinofanira kuchinja kumativi ose maviri e c (kukwira↔kudzika). f'(c)=0 mamiriro anodiwa chete ekuti munhu anosarudzwa ave extremum.

x-m-h2-02.title: Power ye2 inogara iri huru kupfuura square ye x here?
x-m-h2-02.goal: Tsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa kuchirevo chekuti 2ˣ>x² inogara ichishanda, uye utonge kuti nei unogona kutaura kuti inoshanda kubva pakukosha kupi.
x-m-h2-02.material: Seojin akaona kuti kana x=1, 2¹=2>1², uye kana x=5, 2⁵=32>5²=25, akati, ‘Kune positive integer x, 2ˣ inogara iri huru kupfuura x².’ (2ˣ ihuwandu hwaunowana kana ukawedzera 2 nayo pachayo nguva x, uye x² ihuwandu hwaunowana kana ukawedzera x kaviri.)
x-m-h2-02.thinking.1: Paradzanisa kutarisa nyaya dzimwe nekutsanangura kuti nei
x-m-h2-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva ma exponent nekuverenga ma power
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.prompt: Tsvaga ma positive integer x maviri akasiyana anoratidza kuti chirevo chaSeojin hachina kururama. (Ndiko kuti, x apo 2ˣ isiri huru kupfuura x², ndiko kuti, 2ˣ ≤ x².)
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x=1, 2, 3, ... nenzira yakarongeka uye unyore makosha e 2ˣ ne x² padivi pemumwe.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa makosha ari pakati pe x=1 ne x=5 akatariswa naSeojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva integer iri 1 kana kupfuura.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Kune x iyi, 2ˣ yakakura kupfuura x². Haisi kukosha kunoputsa chirevo chaSeojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.explain: Kana x=2, ipapo 2²=4=2²; kana x=3, ipapo 2³=8<9=3²; kana x=4, ipapo 2⁴=16=4². Idzi nhatu ndiyo mienzaniso inopikisa. Pa x=1 kana x=5, 2ˣ yakakura.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.prompt: Zvino unoda kuti, ‘Kune integer x imwe neimwe iri 5 kana kupfuura, 2ˣ>x².’ Chikonzero chakakodzera zvakanyanya chekuti izvi zvinogara zvichishanda ndechipi?
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Paradzanisa kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inoti ‘nei zvakadaro kune x yese’ kana inongoti ‘nyaya dzingani dzakatarisirwa’.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mutafura kuti makosha maviri imwe neimwe inova nguva dzakawanda sei kana ichibva pa x=5 kuenda ku6 ne7.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.a: Ndakaverenga rimwe nerimwe kubva pa x=5 kusvika pa x=20 ndikawana 2ˣ>x² nguva yega yega pasina zvakasiyana
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.a: Kunyangwe ukatarisa nyaya 20, haugoni kuziva kuti kukosha kunotevera kunoshanda here. Kutarisa nyaya dzimwe humbowo, kwete chikonzero.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.b: Kana x ichiwedzera ne1, 2ˣ inoita kaviri, uye x² inokura nezvishoma pane kaviri (kune x≥3)
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvinoenzanisa kuti makosha maviri imwe neimwe inokura zvakadini danho rega rega uye zvinowana kuti nei musiyano uchiramba uchiwedzera.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.c: 2ˣ ifunction ye exponential uye x² ifunction ye polynomial, saka 2ˣ yakakura kubva pa5 zvichienda mberi
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.c: Chokwadi kuti exponential function inopedzisira yakura, asi haina kudaro kubva pakutanga, sepa x=3. Izvi hazvitsanangure kubva papi.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.d: Kana ukadhirowa ma graph, graph ye 2ˣ iri pamusoro pe graph ye x²
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.d: Graph inobatsira pakufungidzira, asi pane ma graph maviri ari padhuze zvikuru zvakaoma kutaura nemaziso, uye haitsanangure chikonzero.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.explain: Pa x=5, 2⁵=32>25, uye kana x ichiwedzera ne1, 2ˣ inoita kaviri ukuwo x² inova (x+1)²/x² nguva, iyo iri pasi pe2 kana x≥3. Saka kana yatanga kutungamira, musiyano unoramba uchiwedzera. Kutarisa makosha mashoma, rudzi rwe function, kana chimiro che graph oga hazvitsanangure ‘x yese’.

x-m-h2-03.title: sinθ=3/5 oga inogona kutiudza tanθ here?
x-m-h2-03.goal: Tsvaga iwe pachako nyaya apo ruzivo rwakapiwa rusingatari kukosha kumwe chete, uye usarudze ruzivo rwunodiwa kutara kukosha.
x-m-h2-03.material: Jihu akangoti ‘sinθ=3/5 kune kona θ’ uye akabvunza kukosha kwe tanθ. Daeun akati, ‘Ruzivo harukwani,’ uye Hyunwoo akati, ‘Rwakakwana.’ Nzira yekuverenga: sinθ ndi sine theta, cosθ ndi cosine theta, tanθ ndi tangent theta, uye 3/5 ndi matatu pamashanu.
x-m-h2-03.prereq.0: Zvinotsanangurwa ne trigonometric function nehukama hwekutanga
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana pane kona θ ine sinθ=3/5, tsvaga mapeya maviri akasiyana anogoneka emakosha (cosθ, tanθ). (Isa cosθ=c ne tanθ=t; unogona kunyora ma decimal. semuenzaniso 3/5=0.6)
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa sinθ=0.6 mu sin²θ+cos²θ=1 uye unyore kuti equation ye cosθ inova chii.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti makosha mangani e cosθ anogutsa equation iyoyo, uye uverenge tanθ=sinθ÷cosθ kune imwe neimwe.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c1: Haiiti sin²θ+cos²θ=1. Tarisa kuti square ye cosθ inofanira kuva chii kana sinθ=0.6.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.explain: Kana sinθ=3/5, ipapo cos²θ=16/25, saka cosθ=4/5 kana −4/5. Kana cosθ=0.8, tanθ=0.75, uye kana cosθ=−0.8, tanθ=−0.75, saka nyaya mbiri dzinogoneka.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.prompt: Kana uchiudzwawo chimwe chezvinotevera pamusoro pe sinθ=3/5, kukosha kwe tanθ kunotarwa kuva rimwe chete. Sarudza zvikamu zvose zveruzivo zvakadaro.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana mamiriro maviri awakawana pakutanga anogutsa mamiriro asarudzo imwe neimwe.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Siyanisa sarudzo apo mamiriro ose maviri anogutsa mamiriro nesarudzo apo imwe chete yasara.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.a: Angle ye positive inogona kuva mu quadrant ipi neipi. Tarisa kana mamiriro ose maviri awakagadzira pakutanga achiramba.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.b: θ i angle iri mu second quadrant
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.b: Mamiriro aya anosiya imwe chete pamamiriro maviri. Tarisa chiratidzo che cosθ mu second quadrant.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.c: θ i angle iri mu first kana second quadrant
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.c: Kana sinθ=3/5>0, watoziva izvi, saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva. Mamiriro ose maviri anoramba.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.d: Kana sinθ>0 ne tanθ<0, chiratidzo che cosθ chakagadzirwa. Tarisa kuti ndeapi pamamiriro maviri apfuura anoramba.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.e: Renji iyi inosanganisira first ne second quadrants zvose, saka mamiriro ose maviri anoramba.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.f: Inokuudza chiratidzo che cosθ zvakananga, saka imwe chete pamamiriro maviri inosara.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.explain: Kana sinθ=3/5, ipapo cosθ=±4/5, saka kana uchiziva chiratidzo che cosθ, tanθ yakagadzirwa. Second quadrant, tanθ<0 (cosθ<0 sezvo sinθ>0), ne cosθ<0 zvose zvinoreva cosθ<0, saka tanθ=−3/4 yakagadzirwa. Kune mamwe, mamiriro e cosθ>0 anoramba, saka kune mitengo miviri ye tanθ.
